messages:
marie: FYI opened a docs PR for the private installer — adds a compact example for packaging a CA + intermediate certificate chain for air-gapped installs. PR link: <http://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/1234>
raj: thanks — can you include an example for KMS client trust store too? many onprem customers expect that.
tyler: quick Q: where does the installer look for the chain by default? /etc/redwood/ssl/ or /opt/redwood/ssl/?
infra-ops: default path is /etc/redwood/ssl/chain.pem — we should document the override via INSTALLER_CERT_PATH env var.
sarah: can we add a tiny openssl + tar snippet showing how to bundle the certs for the offline bundle? one-liner would be ideal.
marie: yep, pushed update in the branch. example shows .tar.gz layout and a systemd drop-in note. snippet added below.
marie: ```bash
# bundle server + intermediate certs for offline installer
cat server.crt intermediate.crt > chain.pem
tar -czf certs.tar.gz chain.pem ca.crt
# verify contents
tar -tzf certs.tar.gz
```
raj: also add a short HSM/KMS callout: do NOT include private keys in the tar for HSM customers. private keys are managed by the HSM/KMS.
marie: added that note verbatim: "HSM users: provide certs only; private keys must remain in the HSM/KMS and MUST NOT be packaged."
tyler: I also fixed two broken links in private/installer/ (they were pointing to the old ssl-guide). can someone run the docs link-checker before we merge?
docs-bot: link-checker queued by @tyler — results: 2 broken links in private/installer (now fixed in branch).
marie: added a small systemd drop-in example to set INSTALLER_CERT_PATH for the installer service:
```ini
[Service]
Environment=INSTALLER_CERT_PATH=/etc/redwood/ssl/chain.pem
```
infra-ops: approved the layout and env override. one operational nit: call out SELinux contexts on RHEL/CentOS. suggested text: "Run `chcon -t etc_t /etc/redwood/ssl/*` after installing certs when SELinux is enforcing."
sarah: LGTM after SELinux note and HSM callout. also please add a single sentence about file permissions (600 for keys, 644 for certs) even though HSM users skip keys.
marie: added both. summarized changes in the PR description and squashed commits. requesting reviews from eng-runtime and security. cc @raj @tyler @sarah
tyler: :thumbsup:
raj: thanks — will merge once CI + link checks pass.
